They were examined (genitalia of males dissected) and found to be all misidentified and belonging to three different species: M. annulitarsus (Sedlec, 23. vii. 1996, H. Hiršová lgt., 1 ♁ 3 ♀♀), M. truncorum Meigen, 1824 (Děvín, 12. vi. 1994, R. Rozkošný lgt., 1 ♁), and M. pallipes (Zetterstedt, 1843) (Kotel, 25. vii. 1995, J. Vaňhara lgt., 1 ♁). Consequently, M. relicta must be removed from the list of Czech fauna, which implies that it is currently only known from Russia.
